verdict.rationale: Grafana's provisioning and observability-as-code docs show dashboards/data sources can be defined as code and version controlled via Git, enabling review and CI/CD-based rollback (grafana-docs-2, grafana-docs-3, grafana-docs-16, grafana-docs-26). However, there is no explicit documentation of a built-in rollback/revert UI for alerts or automations, nor independent evidence of teams using this workflow for review cycles. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo mechanism documentation, evidence of PR-based review workflows in practice, and community confirmation that this versioning process works well for automations beyond dashboards.
